Risk review entry — 30 September 2026
Instrument: iShares USD Treasury Bond 3–7yr UCITS ETF
Account allocation: 40% MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund / 60% MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund
Exposure limit: 4.25% of account value

Finding: Compliant on the available evidence, although exact exposure cannot be determined.

The September 2026 records establish a direct long ETF exposure of 5.17% within MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund. The ETF does not appear among MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund's ten largest holdings, but that omission does not demonstrate a zero holding. Its exact September 2026 weight therefore remains unconfirmed.
Exposure calculation
Component	Account weight	ETF weight in fund	Account contribution
MyMap 3 Select ESG	40%	5.17%	2.068%
MyMap 5 Select ESG	60%	0%–3.19%	0%–1.914%
Total	100%		2.068%–3.982%

The MyMap 5 factsheet reports its tenth-largest holding at 3.19%. Consequently, the named ETF, which is absent from the top ten, cannot exceed 3.19% on the stated direct-long-holding basis.
\[
(40\%\times5.17\%)+(60\%\times3.19\%)
=\boxed{3.982\%}
\]

The maximum supported exposure is 3.982%, leaving at least 0.268 percentage points of headroom against the 4.25% limit.

Source	Relevant pages	Evidence
MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund, Class S Acc GBP factsheet, September 2026	pp. 1, 3	Holdings dated 30 September 2026; named ETF shown as “ISHS $ TRSY BOND 3-7 YR UCITS ETF”, 5.17%.  MyMap_3_Select_ESG.pdf
MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund, Class X Acc GBP factsheet, September 2026	pp. 1, 3	Holdings dated 30 September 2026; named ETF absent from top ten; tenth holding 3.19%.  MyMap_5_Select_ESG.pdf
BlackRock Investment Funds Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements, year ended 28 February 2025	Printed pp. 251, 316 (PDF pp. 252, 317)	Historical direct holdings: MyMap 3 at 3.68% and MyMap 5 at 1.01%. These are not September 2026 figures and are excluded from the calculation.

Both September factsheets specify on page 1 that portfolio information is dated 30 September 2026, while other data is dated 9 October 2026. 
MyMap_3_Select_ESG.pdf
 MyMap_5_Select_ESG.pdf

Reviewer conclusion: No breach is supported by the supplied records. The maximum defensible direct long exposure, 3.982%, is below the 4.25% limit. The exact exposure remains unverified because the September 2026 MyMap 5 factsheet provides only its top ten holdings. This finding excludes other Treasury ETFs, indirect underlying exposures and derivatives, as required by the defined scope.
